112
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the August 22, 2006/Sravana 31, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Powers to DGCA
*361. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to give more teeth to the Directorate General
of Civil Aviation (DGCA);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Loss of fuel due to delay in landing of
flights
*362. SHRI SHANTARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that commercial
flight aircrafts have to hover over important
airports like Mumbai, Delhi and Kolkata
for  30 to 60 minutes both during morning
and evening hours before landing;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the loss in terms of fuel, if estimated,
due to the same?
Development of Ranchi Airport
†*363. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India has formulated any plan to upgrade
the airport at Ranchi, the Capital of
Jharkhand, to international level;
(b) if so, by when the plan would be
taken up alongwith the estimated cost
thereof;
(c) whether State Government is
extending its cooperation to the scheme;
and
(d) the number of years the scheme
would take for its completion?
Menace of touts at airports
*364. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR : Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the general complaint of the foreign tourists
being cheated by touts operating at various
airports in the country particularly at
Bhuntar Airport, Himachal Pradesh;

113
(b) if so, whether they are reportedly
acting in connivance with the taxi operators,
trolley retrieving staff and other subordinate
staff;
(c) if so, whether any enquiry has been
initiated in this matter;
(d) if so, the results thereof; and
(e) the follow-up action taken or
proposed to be taken by Government
thereon?
Assistance to AP under Accelerated
Irrigation Benefit Programme
*365. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Andhra Pradesh State
Government have asked the Centre to
enhance the allocation of Rs. 8000 crore
per year under the Accelerated Irrigation
Benefit Programme in the next five years;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Variations in rates of VAT between
States
*366. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
variations in rates of VAT between State-
to-State still exist due to some of the
decisions taken by the Empowered
Committee;
(b) if so, the details of decisions because
of which there is a variation in VAT rates in
some of the States;
(c) whether it is also a fact that some of
the States have deviated from the EC
approved rate structure;
(d) if so, the details of States which
have deviated from this; and
(e) what action the Ministry is taking
or proposed to take to pursuade the States
to follow the EC approved VAT structure?
Protection to SSI of Gujarat
*367. SHRI SURYAKANTBHAI
ACHARYA:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the request of the State
Government of Gujarat for rationalization
of duty structure in respect of drugs and
pharmaceuticals by bringing down the rate
of excise duty from 16 per cent to 8 per
cent has been turned down;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any alternative steps are
being taken by Government to protect the
adversely affected small scale industries of
Gujarat; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Utilization of amount under IEPF
*368. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken to utilize the
amount available under the Investor
Education and Protection Fund (IEPF);
(b) whether the amount sanctioned and
disbursed to the Investors Association is
very late in a financial year;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) the number of proposals received
from the Investors Association during the
last one year;

114

(e) the funds sanctioned for the year
2005-06 and the programme chalked out
for the year 2005-06;
(f) the status of the total fund credited
to IEPF till now;
(g) whether Government are considering
to transfer the said fund to SEBI; and
(h) if so, the details thereof?
Restoration and maintenance work of
monuments to private agencies

SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the August 22, 2006/Sravana 31, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of Jabalpur airport
†2569. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Madhya Pradesh had
provided land free for the development of
airport at Jabalpur;
(b) the number of works like terminal
building, night landing facility etc.
completed so far after acquiring the land;
and
(c) by when, the above construction
work will be completed?
Clearance of purchase of aircraft by
AAC
2570. SHRI ALI ANWAR:
SHRI SHARAD YADAV:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of aircrafts which
the Aircraft Acquisition Committee (AAC)
of the Ministry have cleared for purchase
by Jet Airways and Indigo Airlines during
the last two years;
(b) what is the source of funding
declared before the AAC; and
(c)whether Government have verified
the source of funding of the aircrafts and if
so, the details thereof?
Cancellation of flights of Indian
Airlines
2571. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the average hour a day an air-craft
remains above the ground;
(b) the average number of flights a day
that the air-crafts of Indian Airlines get
delayed or get cancelled in the month of
July, 2006;
(c) the main reasons of delay or
cancellation in such a big number; and
(d) the remedy that Government
propose to take to avoid the change in
Schedule?

594
Upgradation of Bagdogra airport
†2572. SHRI SAMAN PATHAK: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal for upgradation
of Bagdogra airport into international
airport is under consideration of
Government;
(b) if so, the status of this proposal
alongwith the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Air services in Chhattisgarh
†2573. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Chhattisgarh have submitted a proposal to
the Central Government for getting
approval for introducing air service in the
interiors of the State;
(b) if so, the date since when it is pending
with the Central Government for approval;
(c) whether any progress has been made
in granting approval to the proposal; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Long working hours for pilots
2574. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
news reports stating that many airlines force
their pilots to fly for longer hours, thus
endangering the security of air passengers;
(b) if so, the details of any action
contemplated or taken in this regard;
(c) whether the international system of
upper-limit of maximum flying hours for
commercial pilots exists in India; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Improvement of Delhi and Mumbai
airports
2575. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have warned
private sector managements of strict action
if they do not adhere to their promises of
improving Mumbai and Delhi airports;
(b) what was the context in which this
warning was made;
(c) whether Government are unhappy
with the lack of progress; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Operation of flights from Delhi
airport
2576. SHRI K.P.K. KUMARAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether many flights are circling for
15 minutes or more, before landing at Delhi
airport;
(b) whether any study has been made
of how much fuel is lost because of this;
(c) whether this situation has come
about because license has been given to too
many flights to operate from Delhi airport
when compared to the infrastructure
available; and
(d) what are the steps taken to remedy
this situation?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

595
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Policy on pricing of tickets
2577. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
plan to give domestic carriers a free hand in
pricing tickets;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this is a
departure from the present norms whereby
now the airlines have to get prior
permission of the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) before announcing
new fares and schedules;and
(c) if so, the important details of the
new policy?
Development of Khajuraho airport
†2578. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the land acquired so far for the
development of Khajuraho airport;
(b) the latest position of development
works
